text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on optimal zoning of forested land using a stylized, hypothetical forest management unit—not a national-scale spatial implementation. The study area is a constructed 2-million-hectare landscape split evenly between public and private land, explicitly described as a "simple stylized forest management unit" to allow general policy analysis. It does not cover an entire country or provide national-scale LULC projections. Additionally, while it models land allocation to management zones (which loosely relate to land use), the primary focus is economic optimization under policy scenarios involving exotic plantations and harvest scheduling—not LULC prediction per se. The model lacks quantitative LULC accuracy metrics, mapped national projections, and uses predetermined yield curves rather than predictive LULC modeling. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria related to national-scale implementation and primary focus on LULC prediction.)
